title: TORUS: A Unified Closed-Loop Benchmark for Unified Audio Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.28896v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Unified audio models capable of audio understanding, audio generation and, increasingly, audio editing are proliferating rapidly. However, each capability is evaluated in isolation on specialized benchmarks and a basic question remains unanswered: can these models understand the audio they generate/edit i.e. do they exhibit audio understanding-generation self-coherence (UGC_OWN)? We introduce TORUS, an audio-native unified benchmark for holistic, closed-loop evaluation of unified audio models comprising 1,053 questions (117 tests) spanning 21 tasks and 8 audio domain settings across all 3 audio types. We evaluate unified models and cascades of specialized models across objective and subjective metrics. Best unified models are able to answer only 52.4% questions about their generations, while gpt-audio can answer 53.6% questions. translated_title: TORUS：面向统一音频模型的统一闭环基准测试
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2607.28896v2，公告类型：replace-cross）：能够进行音频理解、音频生成以及日益增多的音频编辑的统一音频模型正在迅速涌现。然而，每种能力目前都在专门的基准测试中被孤立评估，一个基本问题仍未得到解答：这些模型能否理解它们自己生成/编辑的音频，即它们是否表现出音频理解-生成自一致性（UGC_OWN）？我们提出了TORUS，这是一个音频原生的统一基准，用于对统一音频模型进行全面的闭环评估，包含1,053个问题（117个测试），涵盖21个任务和8种音频领域设置，跨越所有3种音频类型。我们在客观和主观指标上评估了统一模型以及由专门模型组成的级联系统。结果显示，最好的统一模型只能回答关于其自身生成音频的52.4%的问题，而gpt-audio能回答53.6%的问题。我们假设真正统一的音频智能应具有高度自一致性，因此提出……
tldr: 提出TORUS——首个音频原生的统一闭环基准，用于评估统一音频模型能否理解自己生成或编辑的音频，发现最佳模型的自一致性仅约52%-54%，揭示了当前统一音频模型在理解-生成自一致性上的重大缺陷。
en_tdlr: TORUS is a unified closed-loop benchmark for evaluating whether unified audio models can understand the audio they generate or edit, revealing that even the best models answer only about 52-54% of questions about their own outputs, exposing a major gap in audio understanding-generation self-coherence.
